decision: The CLI includes a graph command that emits Graphviz DOT for relationships around a starting knowledge-unit ID. The command traverses both outgoing references and backlinks up to a configurable depth, can include or exclude specific spec types, writes to stdout by default, and can write to a requested output path.
name: Generate Graphviz relationship graphs
description: Documents the Graphviz DOT CLI export so Lattice relationship graphs can be generated from the same canonical registry references used by rendered docs.
